mentions.name: Netsplit
mentions.description: A free, open-source IRC client for macOS, built for nostalgia and customized with the features the developer likes while avoiding the ones they don't.
mentions.source_excerpt: Had a moment of nostalgia and started building an IRC client for macOS. It’s totally free/open source. And has been fun to customize / add the features I like to see while avoiding the ones I don’t.
mentions.author: richstokes
